items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 4:1
items.html: For the entire matter of the raising of MAN is the arousal of the connection that Bina of AVI has with ZON of AVI, to impart to them the illumination of Hochma, as written (Part 7, answer 35). And from this comes the rule that MAN rises only from the aspects of ZON in every Sefira, and the place of the rising is the Bina in every Sefira. (Inner Light, page 604, Sub Header, “And They Need”)
